Van Der Heyden S. Red Card

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Francisco Maeso shows the yellow card to Sergi Darder (Mallorca) for a heavy challenge.
90+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.

90+1' Yan Couto (Girona) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Predrag Rajkovic sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. Girona have been awarded a corner kick.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Aleix Garcia (Girona) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
89' Jose Copete (Mallorca) is penalised for holding. Francisco Maeso signals a set piece. Girona get a free kick.
87' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Portu (Girona).
86' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
85' Savio (Girona) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.

84' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
84' The referee signals a corner kick to Girona.

84' Yan Couto (Girona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Girona.

82' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the left post from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
81' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Paulo Gazzaniga, who smothers the ball.
79' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
78' Michel has decided to substitute Jhon Elmer Solis Romero and he is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
78' The substitution is prepared. Samu Costa (Mallorca) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Omar Mascarell.
76' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) is booked for saying more than Francisco Maeso was willing to tolerate.
76' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
75' Savio (Girona) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him. Girona will take a corner kick.
74' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
74' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Francisco Maeso ignores the protests.

73' Portu (Girona) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the roof of the net. It's a great effort but an even better save from Predrag Rajkovic, who tips the ball over the bar. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Girona.
73' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

70' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
68' Cyle Larin goes off the pitch and Abdon Prats (Mallorca) comes on.
68' Javier Aguirre has decided to make a change. Sergi Darder (Mallorca) replaces Daniel Rodriguez.

67' Savio (Girona) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
65' Savio (Girona) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
65' Portu (Girona) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.

60' Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
59' A yellow card for a tackle by Toni Lato (Mallorca). Francisco Maeso doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
56' Portu (Girona) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
56' Foul! Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Girona have a free kick.
55' Javier Aguirre prepares a substitution. Martin Valjent is replaced by Nacho Vidal (Mallorca).
55' Here comes a substitution. Antonio Sanchez is given a rest as he is replaced by Manu Morlanes (Mallorca).
55' Here is a change. Ivan Martin is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Portu (Girona).
51' Jose Copete (Mallorca) brings his opponent down. Francisco Maeso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Yan Couto (Girona) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Francisco Maeso who sees an offensive foul.
49' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but he sent it well over the bar.
48' The ball goes out for a corner. Mallorca can continue in their attacking effort.
48' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Cyle Larin (Mallorca) inside the box. Mallorca earn a corner.
47' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
46' Aleix Garcia (Girona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Francisco Maeso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Referee Francisco Maeso halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Michel, then shows him a yellow.
45+2' Savio (Girona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Ivan Martin (Girona) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
44' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle. Jose Copete (Mallorca) commits a foul after dangerous play.
44' Savio (Girona) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
43' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) releases Cyle Larin with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
39' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
38' Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the middle of the goal, but Predrag Rajkovic was alert and made an amazing save!
37' Francisco Maeso shows a yellow card to Martin Valjent (Mallorca) for a tough tackle.
36' Savio (Girona) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
35' No handball! Referee Francisco Maeso points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Mallorca players.
35' Wait! Referee Francisco Maeso has indicated he is going to review the Mallorca goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
33' 1 - 0 Goal! Jose Copete (Mallorca) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 1:0.
32' Mallorca get a corner.
30' Half-chance! Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) plays a pass into the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga reacts well to snuff out the attack.
30' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
29' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mallorca comes to nothing.
27' The Girona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
23' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) plays a through ball but overhits it.
22' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
17' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
14' It should have been a goal! Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
14' Mallorca quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
13' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
11' Mallorca failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
9' Ivan Martin (Girona) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Predrag Rajkovic makes a comfortable save.
7' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
6' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
6' The resulting set piece from Mallorca is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
4' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Cyle Larin (Mallorca), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
3' Francisco Maeso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca).
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Mallorca will kick-off.
Francisco Maeso is introduced as the referee for today's match.
